organisers.name: [{Nevins Chan Pak Hoong (陈百鸿)}{mailto:nhoong@worldcubeassociation.org}] [{UK Cube Association}{mailto:contact@ukca.org}]

venue.name: Wythenshawe Forum
venue.address: Forum Centre, Simonsway, Wythenshawe, Manchester M22 5RX

items.information: ##Please note that this competition is taking place over Easter weekend. Please read all the information in the **FAQ** and the **Important Information** tabs before registering. **Spectators may attend for free. There is no need to book!** PLEASE NOTE: For this competition, there will be a competitor limit of 20 for Multi-Blind on a first come first serve basis. If you register for Multi-Blind and are not within the first 20 people registered, your registration for the event will be removed. However we will be keeping a waiting list for this specific event in the case of dropouts before the competition. Please only consider registering for this event if you are certain you would like to compete in it. items.name: Washtenaw FMC 2 2025

venue.name: Morris J. Lawrence Building
venue.address: 4800 E Huron River Dr, Ann Arbor, MI 48105

items.information: **This is not a regular speedsolving competition and does NOT feature speedsolving events.** The only event at this competition is FMC and there will not be normal 3x3. If you are a new competitor, we recommend registering for [Washtenaw Spring 2025](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/WashtenawSpring2025), which is being held the day after this competition in the same building. This competition takes place on a **FRIDAY** evening. Guests may only be in the room during official FMC attempts if they are quiet for the duration of the FMC attempt. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6Njc3NTYsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--6717e09ba0dee0bb3439346918b8a24a4a11be62/image.png)
